name: Sealer + Clear - int_door_slab
intent: Sanding sealer + clear topcoat with interstage sanding. Apply tasks fire through TSK_DOOR_BRUSH/SPRAY keepers; the per-task_ref material_type selects the right TRADE_MATERIAL factor (WB_SEALER_BRUSH/SPRAY for the sealer pass, WB_CLEAR_BRUSH/SPRAY for the clear pass). Interstage sanding folds onto TSK_DOOR_LIGHT_SAND — same physical work as paint interstage sand; the grit doctrine (220-320 between sealer, 320-400 between clear) is a painter-level detail the estimating layer doesn't differentiate.
doctrine: Sealer+clear for int_door_slab. Interstage sanding required for stain/clear. NO roll for clear. QT3=0+1, QT4=1+2, QT5=2+3. Universal-keeper migration 2026-05-11: TSK_DSST_SEALER_BRUSH/SPRAY + TSK_DSST_CLEAR_BRUSH/SPRAY (4 tasks) collapsed onto TSK_DOOR_BRUSH/SPRAY keepers; TSK_DSST_SAND_SEALER + TSK_DSST_SAND_CLEAR (2 tasks) collapsed onto TSK_DOOR_LIGHT_SAND. Brush variants get 0.9× time (clear/sealer flow faster than paint when brushed); spray variants are 1.0× (sprayer viscosity-agnostic). Rate drift accepted per 'rates later' deferral.
